task_card.title: Outpaint flow - extend the frame on a crop gizmo, Krea 2 fills the black

next_action.description: Run /mpi-flow-graphics for the Outpaint flow — the 4/5 tile still + the wide autoplaying hero clip, named flow-outpaint.webp / flow-outpaint.mp4 under comfy_workflows/display/, then declare `preview` and `video` on the outpaint FlowDef (they are deliberately undeclared right now so nothing 404s). The obvious hero is a reveal: the source frame with its black bars, wiping to the filled result. Two real proof images are already on disk in Documents/Cubric Vision/Projects/mpi-594-outpaint-proof/Media/ (flowOutpaint_001/002.png, 928x1136) with the source at mpi-546-smoke/Media/t2i_004.png.

key_decisions: The APP pads the picture, not the graph. The crop step composes source + black bars into one PNG, places it in Media/.preview-assets, and that file is what Input_Image loads — so the graph has no rect, mask, pad node or fill input.

MpiStepCrop MOUNTS CropManager (the History crop tool's own engine) rather than porting it, so drag/snap/handles stay one implementation. Two deliberate divergences: a ratio CONTAINS the image instead of inscribing it, and the fill is hardcoded black.
The ratio + orientation bar is the GIZMO's, not declared `fields`, because the ratio list is orientation-dynamic and a declared field's options are static.
Fabio's ImageScaleToTotalPixels (~1MP) is an OOM guard for 4K inputs, NOT a defect — the output being smaller than the padded input is expected. Do not remove it.
The NSFW arm needs no GPU pass: Fabio has run the lustify weight against this same edit shape before, and the pick reaching the graph is verified.
constraints: A flow with NO prompt must never TITLE its prompt node Input_Positive: _buildParams emits `Input_Positive: positive || ''` every run and would wipe the bake. Outpaint's node 112 is 'Outpaint instruction (baked)' and the inject-titles test pins its ABSENCE. Do NOT 'fix' this app-side — ~20 graphs rely on that empty string to erase leftover authoring prompts.

sync-raw-workflows.mjs REFUSES while any generated file under comfy_workflows/ is dirty. A peer session's flow_character_sheet.json was dirty all session; the workaround was `COMFY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:48188 node scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs <raw>` to convert independently and diff before touching the runtime file.
The outpaint FlowDef declares NO `preview`/`video` on purpose — a filename that 404s is worse than an empty tile. Add both in the same edit as the art.
A probe project lives at Documents/Cubric Vision/Projects/mpi-594-outpaint-proof (Fabio said leave it). It holds the two proof generations.
